title: Let the Name clear the fog
summary: The Guru plants Naam so doubt gives way to light and direction. Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
takeaway: Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
lifeApplication: Before chasing another explanation, return to the line and sing one praise. Stay with the light already given until the next step is visible.

source.lifeApplication: Before reaching for another answer, stay with the Name until the path brightens.
